taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: Systems Manager command/session delegation to managed instances
controls.source_trace: Trace who chooses a document/target and whether permitted parameters delegate unintended process or instance authority. Separate SendCommand from session or document-update permissions.
controls.implementation_branch: Separate SendCommand, StartSession and document creation/update/default-version selection. Evaluate target conditions against actual mutable instance tags and the selected document version. IAM permission to invoke a document does not sanitize its parameters: inspect the installed agent/document interpolation behavior. Session shell access and one constrained document action carry different effective authority.
controls.controlled_verification: Use an isolated owned managed-node fixture or source-policy proof with an inert command document; compare intended target/document and an out-of-policy selection.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Access to an instance inventory is not command execution. Never test with destructive shell commands or unrelated production instances.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Bind document/target/parameter authority and verify permitted diagnostics and rejected delegation.
